title: Blueberry: Horizons
description: Modified Cobblemon Modpack with additional features to play Blueberry: Horizons server!
body:
Have you ever thought about what Cobblemon would look like if you implemented as many aspects from TV series and games? You play single-player and feel like your world is full of Cobblemon's but not real trainers? Then keep reading and I might interest you in our project.

**Blueberry: Horizons** is a season-based project going for its third season. We're looking for new players who enjoy building, battling, and exploring a world full of Cobblemon. We provide fully non-pay-to-win content, and we have most of the popular features like; **Raids**, **Dungeons**, **MMR Ranked Battles**, **Player Gyms**, **Regions**, **Every Cobblemon implemented**, and more.

We also have a friendly community that helps new people to get on track with their journey and hosts a variety of events like: **Build Competitions**, **Draft Leagues**, S**hiny Hunting Weekends**, **Treasure Hunting**, **Tournaments**. From time to time we host giveaways in which you can win unique Cobblemon Skins.

So if you're looking for a place to relax, find new friends, and enjoy your gameplay without any restrictions or paywalled features, go straight to our Discord and apply to get whitelisted on the server!
